title: Chapter 38 Pride
content:
Chapter 38 Pride

"All put down their weapons, put their arms on their backs, and squat down." Wang Er and his surrounding companions held spears together. Pointing at those barbarians, threatening them to put down their resistance together, obediently obeying their own inclusion.

I don't know how many times this has happened, fifty, or 100. Countless repeating the same thing, although it's cool, watching others lay down their weapons and wait like a lamb to be slaughtered.

But people are all beings who like the new and hate the old, or in other words, all living beings who already have feelings are the beings who love the new and hate the old. No one wants to keep repeating the same thing, day after day, year after year, over and over again, as if there is no end.

That kind of feeling will definitely drive people crazy. This is also why many people in the past live a life that others think is very good, but yearn for the miserable life that those poor people live. This is this kind of emotion at work.

Now these sturdy soldiers, that is, the feeling they have experienced, they have never experienced the cruelty of war before, and they continue to receive them so leisurely. Every tribe of barbarians did not find any major accidents on the way.

Just like traveling, except for accidents, there is no threat at all, as if the scenery on the continuous sightseeing grassland, except that there are a little more people, there is no difference when you have to obey the rules when you are on the road.

So before, Zhong Yu would say that these people are of no use other than being an honor guard. Through the constant wars before, without the slightest danger, they have won countless victories and wiped out dozens or hundreds of small tribes.

Seeing those savages shivering under their own guns, they did not dare to resist in the slightest. Even with one or two exceptions, they were all killed and injured under the crossbows of those guard knights. With such an arrogance in his heart, his heart is also so high, his eyes are also raised high, and he can't look down on any savage.

In the bottom of my heart, there is such an aura of the boss of the lord, the second child of the knight, and the third child of mine. Although they were on the road, apart from their strong momentum and looking at the prisoners, they didn't play a big role. It was those knights who were sweeping away any threats, and they were playing support next to them.

But through this ordinary victory, the accumulated pride still makes them look down on any barbarians, even the servants of these barbarians around them, they look down on them in the slightest.

There have been many contradictions and conflicts on the way, Zhong Yu is very clear in his heart. These strong soldiers still do not understand, if they really fight with those barbarians, although their number is three hundred, there are only 150 barbarians.

But if they really fight, they will definitely lose, and it will be an absolutely disproportionate defeat. And the barbarians, armed with the same weapons as them, could have wiped out the entire army of these recruits without escaping a single one, with less than fifty losses of their own.

Therefore, Zhong Yu is trying his best to avoid this situation. If any recruits really dare to bully the barbarian servants in front of everyone, he will not tolerate it.

He will definitely be punished severely, so that the recruits will be vigilant, and those barbarians will feel that they are very fair, and they will not favor those yellow-skinned troops, so that they will not come out to make trouble.

Instead, listen to your own words obediently. After all, as long as you are a sentient and rational creature, there is still a bit of anger in your heart. It’s just that they have different degrees of tolerance, but if they are really forced too much , will definitely explode.

This requires Zhong Yu to always maintain a fair and neutral attitude, not to favor any party, to be fair in rewards and punishments, and to deal with justice. That's why this army has been maintained like this, and has maintained this fragile balance with victories one after another.

But Zhong Yu has already decided in his heart that in a few months, he will almost be discovered by the Eddra Tribal Alliance, and then it will be time for him to go to war with those barbarians.

I must send these recruits to the battlefield and become cannon fodder on the front line, so that they can fully understand that war is cruel, they are weak, like ants, they can be trampled to death at will, in order to redeem them today. The sin of causing trouble for yourself today.

Zhong Yu is not a generous person, he is absolutely sure to take revenge if this is the case. A gentleman will take revenge. It is not too late in ten years. A villain will take revenge. From morning to night, although he is not a villain, he is not a gentleman either. .

Therefore, after he has passed a few months, when those soldiers are of little use value, let them taste the cost of causing trouble to them. Let them understand that some things are not impossible, but they must have the strength to do such things.

They are a group of incompetent guys who have not even reached the first rank, and they are not even a formal soldier. What qualifications do they have to be proud in front of themselves, and proud of the group of savages who have killed people and licked blood.

And once you do such a thing, you have to pay for what you have done. The weak, if you don't have a big enough background, must pay the price for provoking the strong.

Another tribe was deceived, deterred by Zhong Yu's powerful strength, and lost all resistance. It became another captured tribe under Zhong Yu's command, adding population to Zhong Yu's territory.

Almost there, as long as one or two more tribes are attacked, he will be able to achieve the biggest result of his trip. In this battle, he eliminated a total of 87 tribes in this fan-shaped area and plundered a population of nearly 4,000 people.

Established, two township-level administrative areas, four pavilion-level settlements. By extending his influence to a radius of almost a hundred miles around him, he can justifiably say that he is a county-level lord, and he can call himself the Marquis of Baili.

And within this 100-mile radius, there are only three large tribes with a population of more than 300 left. Because they take into account their knowledge, they may tear their disguise, so they are temporarily reserved until the end to remove all the forces around them. Exterminate, surround them to keep them from getting away. Therefore, it has not been destroyed by itself.

However, now they gradually became aware of it, and found that there may be an unknown enemy around them. Therefore, all the people who usually go out to hunt in their tribe have been called back, and they are all urgently building the defense of the tribe's camp, and there are usually more dark posts around. Tribal people get ready.

As for Zhong Yu, the army that originally had more than 500 people beside him, you sent him 300 strong recruits and obeyed 100 barbarians, so as to look at the 4,000 prisoners and supervise them to build new ones. Gather point.

There were only 100 guards left, and about fifty barbarian servants. He believes that, to deal with those small tribes whose leaders generally have only second-order cultivation bases and whose troops are less than 200, his own 150 people, with such superior and advanced equipment, are enough to sweep past them, destroying and destroying them.

Gradually, Zhong Yu didn't hide his whereabouts, but brought his army to the door of a tribe with an open and aboveboard. Give them enough time to prepare for the defense. He will use the most powerful strength to destroy the inexplicable pride and confidence in their hearts, so that they will forever leave their powerful figures in their hearts, eroding away like the fear that lingers. to their hearts.
